bio: David Deming is the Danoff Dean of Harvard College, the William Henry Bloomberg Professor of Economics, and the Isabelle and Scott Black Professor of Public Policy at Harvard Kennedy School. From 2021 to 2024 he served as the Academic Dean of HKS. He holds teaching appointments at HKS, FAS, and HGSE.
